routing_principle: Prefer genuine larger discourse and narrative units bounded by Koine temporal, location, participant, question-response, quotation/fulfillment, parable/discourse-frame, closure-formula, passion-transition, phrase/clause syntax, and translation pressure. No single marker is automatic authority.

discourse_closure_formula.phrase: kai egeneto hote etelesen ho Iesous with object variation
discourse_closure_formula.use: Close major discourses and preserve cross-chapter attachment alternatives.

at_that_time.use: Temporal linkage or shift evidence, never automatic chronology.

paragraph_start_counts.interpretation: Correlated editorial/source paragraphing is evidence only, not independent votes or boundary authority.

marker_audit.question_quotation_parable_and_passion_f: Question-response syntax, hina/hopos purpose and quotation frames, tote and idou transitions, parable introductions/explanations, location and participant movement, and passion temporal transitions were evaluated only in phrase/clause/discourse context.

versification_and_source_segmentation.disposition: Preserve canonical coordinates for coverage; do not infer words, omissions, preferred numbering, witness, or reading from bridge/absence metadata.

textual_translation_hard_zones.issue: The eike or without-cause phrase is variant-sensitive.
textual_translation_hard_zones.local_source_observation: All three local Greek views have the shorter 39-token clause; WEB records omission pressure.
textual_translation_hard_zones.boundary_effect: Keep Matt.5.21-26 intact without selecting the shorter or expanded reading.

textual_translation_hard_zones.issue: Expanded enemy-love clauses vary across traditions.
textual_translation_hard_zones.local_source_observation: The local views contain love enemies and pray for persecutors as a 14-token clause.
textual_translation_hard_zones.boundary_effect: Keep Matt.5.43-48; make no reading or doctrinal selection.

textual_translation_hard_zones.issue: The prayer ending and doxology are variant-sensitive.
textual_translation_hard_zones.local_source_observation: The local views end the verse with apo tou ponerou in 12 tokens.
textual_translation_hard_zones.boundary_effect: Keep Matt.6.1-18; no liturgical or textual preference.

textual_translation_hard_zones.issue: The locality name varies among source traditions.
textual_translation_hard_zones.local_source_observation: WEB flags Gadarenes pressure; proper-name variation is not geographic or historical authority.
textual_translation_hard_zones.boundary_effect: Keep Matt.8.28-34 independent of locality spelling.

textual_translation_hard_zones.issue: The family-report verse and numbering are source-sensitive.
textual_translation_hard_zones.local_source_observation: UGNT bridges 12:47-48 while SBLGNT and CNTR expose 12:47 separately.
textual_translation_hard_zones.boundary_effect: Keep Matt.12.46-50; no silent omission or renumbering.

textual_translation_hard_zones.local_source_observation: UGNT and SBLGNT contain both verses; CNTR exposes only the response onset in 16:2 and no 16:3 coordinate.
textual_translation_hard_zones.boundary_effect: Keep Matt.16.1-12; require case review before any dependency claim.

textual_translation_hard_zones.issue: The prayer-fasting verse is omitted or bridge-handled.
textual_translation_hard_zones.local_source_observation: SBLGNT and CNTR omit 17:21; UGNT labels a 17:21-22 bridge carrying the passion-transition text.
textual_translation_hard_zones.boundary_effect: Keep the canonical coordinate in Matt.17.14-21 without selecting a reading.

textual_translation_hard_zones.issue: The saving-the-lost verse is omitted or bridge-handled.
textual_translation_hard_zones.local_source_observation: SBLGNT and CNTR omit 18:11; UGNT bridges 18:11-12 with lost-sheep text.
textual_translation_hard_zones.boundary_effect: Keep Matt.18.1-14; no silent omission or verse-level proof text.

textual_translation_hard_zones.issue: The divorce saying has clause-level expansion pressure.
textual_translation_hard_zones.local_source_observation: UGNT has 17 tokens while SBLGNT and CNTR have 22, including an additional remarriage clause.
textual_translation_hard_zones.boundary_effect: Keep Matt.19.2-12; authorize no marriage or divorce policy.

textual_translation_hard_zones.issue: The first-last close has an expanded saying variant.
textual_translation_hard_zones.local_source_observation: The local views share the nine-token reversal close; other tradition pressure remains external.
textual_translation_hard_zones.boundary_effect: Keep Matt.20.1-16; do not use the variant as boundary or election doctrine authority.

textual_translation_hard_zones.local_source_observation: Local views align on the cup exchange while expansion pressure remains evidence only.
textual_translation_hard_zones.boundary_effect: Keep Matt.20.17-28; decide no sacramental or passion harmonization.

textual_translation_hard_zones.issue: The two sons' responses and order vary.
textual_translation_hard_zones.local_source_observation: UGNT, SBLGNT, and CNTR differ in response wording/order while retaining the whole question-parable frame.

textual_translation_hard_zones.issue: The falling-stone verse has inclusion and bracketing pressure.
textual_translation_hard_zones.local_source_observation: UGNT brackets the verse while SBLGNT and CNTR present it.
textual_translation_hard_zones.boundary_effect: Keep Matt.21.33-46; no automatic omission or imported seam.

textual_translation_hard_zones.issue: The woe verse has omission and numbering pressure.
textual_translation_hard_zones.local_source_observation: SBLGNT and CNTR omit it; UGNT bridges 23:14-15; WEB records order/omission pressure.
textual_translation_hard_zones.boundary_effect: Keep the full Matt.23.13-36 woe catalogue.

textual_translation_hard_zones.local_source_observation: Local views contain the 22-token clause; WEB records addition pressure.
textual_translation_hard_zones.boundary_effect: Keep Matt.24.36-51; authorize no identity, knowledge, or chronology ruling.

textual_translation_hard_zones.local_source_observation: The local views share the 15-token blood-of-covenant clause.
textual_translation_hard_zones.boundary_effect: Keep Matt.26.17-30; authorize no sacramental, covenant-system, or reading decision.

textual_translation_hard_zones.local_source_observation: WEB records attribution omission pressure; local Greek views retain the attribution frame.
textual_translation_hard_zones.boundary_effect: Keep Matt.27.1-10; decide no authorship, canon, source, or harmonization claim.

textual_translation_hard_zones.issue: The prisoner's name varies as Barabbas or Jesus Barabbas.

textual_translation_hard_zones.boundary_effect: Keep Matt.27.11-26; no identity or witness preference.

textual_translation_hard_zones.issue: Commission wording and formula claims attract textual and theological pressure.

textual_translation_hard_zones.boundary_effect: Keep Matt.28.16-20; require external textual review and make no theology or reading selection.

appeals.rationale: The genealogy reckoning closes at 1:17, while the repeated genesis wording can bind genealogy and conception.
The from-then proclamation onset and shoreline calls can be one Galilean beginning movement.
The discourse closure and mountain descent are linked, but teaching and deed cycles remain distinguishable.
The closure formula ends the mission discourse while John's prison question begins a response sequence.
En ekeino to kairo can connect the invitation/rest saying to the Sabbath controversies.
The closure formula at 13:53 can close the parable discourse before the hometown scene rather than open a combined unit.
Apo tote erxato is a major pivot, but confession, passion prediction, and following sayings may form one larger transition.
Peter's tote question can continue correction and agreement through forgiveness and the discourse close.
The gar at 20:1 explains the first-last reversal through the vineyard parable across the chapter edge.
The silencing close and tote audience shift support either a seam or a single authority-and-teaching transition.
Peri de opens a topic shift, but coming, timing, watchfulness, and servant contrast can remain one parent.
The closure formula, Passover prediction, and leadership plot can be grouped as a discourse-to-passion hinge.
The morning council continues the arrest-trial sequence while Judas's death forms a nested scene.
The secured-tomb scene and dawn tomb visit can be one burial-to-resurrection parent.
